description: Open a durable wait for a mailbox and return immediately — the request never hangs. The wait resolves when a matching message arrives, or expires. Match on the address, and optionally narrow by sender and by a case-insensitive subject substring. Poll the returned `waitId` with `get_wait_status`. The resolution is also delivered as the `wait.resolved` webhook event on the account's verified outbound webhook, so a service with no long-running process need not poll at all.

sender.description: Optional: only resolve for mail from this sender address.

subject.description: Optional: only resolve when the subject contains this text (case-insensitive substring).

timeoutMs.description: Optional: how long the wait stays open, in milliseconds (max 24h).

name: wait_for_email
